description.value: Mark Hobson Gallery is the dedicated showroom for Canadian wildlife and landscape artist Mark Hobson, who has painted professionally from Tofino since 1984. His work — executed in watercolour, acrylic, and oil — captures the West Coast's pounding surf, rain forests, and coastal wildlife, with many pieces begun outdoors on location. Touring cyclists rolling into Tofino can browse original paintings, limited-edition giclée prints, and commission custom artwork directly from the artist.
